# .evidence — local build output

Written by `act-mcp` when it runs a GitHub Actions job with `nektos/act`: one
JSONL file per run under `benchmark/<full-sha>/<run_id>.jsonl` and
`coverage/<full-sha>/<run_id>.jsonl`, plus `runs/<run_id>/` (act's own log and
`meta.json`, the terminal-state manifest) and `incoming/<run_id>/` (transient
payload scratch a job wrote through the bind mount).

It is safe to delete any of it; it is regenerated by the next run and is
gitignored on purpose — evidence travels by scanning, not by git. The format is
defined by `docs/adr/0002-evidence-jsonl-contract.md`, not by this file. Do not
hand-edit these files: `act-mcp validate-evidence` will disagree with you.
